notes.title: Heaven Life - the meaning of life
notes.content:
[h1]Hello my friends!
I'm happy to announce a new update regarding 2 of our games:


Heaven Island LIFE with a new FREE DLC for you that you can download,
it inclued all Artworks and emoticons that you can freely use!


And Heaven Forest is now available for you to download
a game about the meaning of life

http://store.steampowered.com/app/476480/


Moreover there is 51% Discount during Christmas sales! ːbuddhaː [/h1]
